thread:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — after the 1.0 launch we've got a steady stream of bug reports + a handful of customer asks. Need agreement on how we split next two sprints (what to 'pull in' vs defer).
Sam L: Agree. Can we codify criteria so triage isn't ad-hoc?
Olivia Chen: My proposal: P0/P1 bugs that affect >5% of sessions OR data loss => immediate hotfix. Everything else goes into a 2-week triage bucket and we batch fixes.
Ben R: +1. For enhancements: prioritize by projected tokens saved OR revenue impact (customer requests with >$X ARR).
Priya G: Also: allocate 20% of squad capacity for exploratory fixes / fast follow-ups so we don't block roadmap.
Maya Patel: Nice. Concrete ask: create checklist for release cutoffs and a triage table. Example rows: impact, repro steps, owner, ETA, rollback plan.
Sam L: I'll spin up a short template. Should we add "quality gate" for shipping enhancements that touch streaming? (we had a streaming regression last week)
Olivia Chen: Yes — any change touching runtime or model selection needs a canary and perf baseline. Tagging tests: `streaming-e2e`, `latency-regression`.
Ben R: For customer-driven features, require: customer ROI, POV signoff, and a simulated load test that matches their usage pattern.
Priya G: What about backlog grooming cadence? Weekly quick triage + deep grooming every other Thurs?
Maya Patel: Weekly quick triage seems right. Deep grooming: carve out 90m next Thursday. We'll invite SRE and CS for context.
Sam L: Who owns the hotfix path? Recommend: on-call eng + product triage lead. deploy-bot can annotate rollback info.
deploy-bot: note: hotfix pipeline runbook updated -> https://confluence.redwood/ops/hotfix-pipeline (new rollback section) :white_check_mark:
Olivia Chen: Decision check: freeze non-critical enhancements for sprint A, accept P0/P1 + small UX fixes (<3d). Sprint B: re-evaluate with QA metrics.
Ben R: Sounds fair. Can we also tag backlog items with "postlaunch-priority" and reason field (bug/customer/perf)? Makes queries easier.
Priya G: I'll add tags and a board filter. Also adding a small prompt-eval set to monitor quality regressions tied to changes.
Maya Patel: Action items: Sam -> template + triage table by EOD. Priya -> tags + board filter by tomorrow. Olivia -> canary baseline checklist by Thu. Ben -> customer ROI gating doc.
Sam L: On it. Quick Q: any objection to keeping 20% capacity reserve?
Olivia Chen: No objection. We can flex it if an outage occurs.
Ben R: Agreed.
Priya G: ack
Maya Patel: Great. We'll revisit after first deep grooming session and surface metrics (regressions, time-to-fix, customer satisfaction). Thanks team :rocket:
Sam L: Thanks!
Olivia Chen: Thanks :thumbsup:
Ben R: 👍
Priya G: 👍
